description: This file defines inline functions related to the fsmonitor feature in Git, specifically for checking if the file system monitor has been refreshed, and for marking cache entries as valid or invalid within the index state. It also includes references to other internal modules related to filesystem monitoring, cache management, and tracing.

methods.name: int is_fsmonitor_refreshed(const struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Checks if the filesystem monitor has been called at least once and if the monitor mode is disabled or has been run at least once.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as valid for filesystem monitoring unless it is a submodule, updating the index state accordingly.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry's validity for filesystem monitoring and triggers untracked cache invalidation.

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_invalid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_valid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/
